purpose: Locate the smallest source insertion point for a retained-gate feasibility probe after the X10-U 80/80 hard-bound gate.

existing_probe_comment.meaning: Existing sparse retained graph probe records that build_expert_mix receives selected IDs and weights, not a retained gate output; graph_gate_output_input_available is hardcoded false.

missing_for_retained_gate: proof that gate is not recomputed in hot/expert path

deepseek4_gate_route.summary: build_moe_v4 computes scores, selected_experts, and weights, then immediately calls build_expert_mix(cur_ffn, selected_experts, weights, layer, il).
deepseek4_gate_route.probe_candidate: Add a default-off diagnostic probe around build_moe_v4 -> build_expert_mix handoff to report whether scores/selection/selected_experts/weights can be passed without recompute and what tensor buffer types/shapes are visible.

default_single_path_expert_compute.summary: Default path computes gate/up, swiglu, down, weights multiply, then sum. It already has native retained down probe around act/experts/down tensors.

generic_moe_route_for_reference.summary: Generic MoE has logits/probs/topk/weights in one builder and expands weights early. This is useful as a reference but DeepSeek4 uses its own build_moe_v4 path.

next_probe_design.intended_patch_scope: diagnostic only; write CSV/JSON rows from graph construction, no runtime token-rate optimization.
minimum_fields: whether build_expert_mix can receive an optional retained_gate_context without recomputing gate
whether selected_experts and weights are already the exact retained data needed by expert mix
next_probe_design.success_gate: Probe must show a dataflow path where build_expert_mix can consume retained selected_experts/weights and avoid gate recompute/extra hot payload. Then a new hard-bound must show generalized min_eval_tok_s >= 5.5 before any performance source patch.
next_probe_design.failure_gate: If probe confirms no retained gate/topk/weights can be threaded without extra payload or recompute, close retained-gate path and switch to compact representation feasibility.

decision.reason: The next source change, if made, should be a default-off non-logit-changing probe to measure eligibility, not a token-rate runtime patch.
